d: Watch as Firstpost examines Sudan’s explosive dossier submitted to the United Nations Security Council and the African Union, formally accusing Ethiopia and the United Arab Emirates of enabling devastating suicide drone attacks deep inside Sudanese territory. Khartoum alleges that the Rapid Support Forces have conducted nearly 200 drone strikes launched from bases inside Ethiopia, including Asosa Airport and Bahir Dar, leaving hundreds of civilians dead and striking critical infrastructure.
